MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, an internal rotation rather than a broad directional signal; Technology is sharply negative while Communication, Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary are positive. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 top performers across 2 sectors); major 1W/1M divergences argue for caution and a watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads at +6.81% for the week, with CHTR (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%) and CMCSA (1W: +12.03% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples (+3.89%) and Consumer Discretionary (+3.21%) follow, with WMT (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +18.08%) and BKNG (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest (-11.89% 1W; -14.09% 1M), with ORCL (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -19.49%) and ASML (1W: -19.04% | 1M: -24.74%) BELOW TREND. Energy (-10.19% 1W) and Industrials (-2.71% 1W) also lag; XOM (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +0.76%) is in CORRECTION, while ETN (1W: -16.94% | 1M: -24.18%) is BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%), BKNG (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), CMCSA (1W: +12.03% | 1M: +19.15%), TTWO (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +4.58%) and LOW (1W: +9.63% | 1M: +25.97%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 across Communication and Consumer Discretionary).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -16.94% | 1M: -24.18%), PANW (1W: -17.32% | 1M: -22.41%), ORCL (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -19.49%), ASML (1W: -19.04% | 1M: -24.74%) and VST (1W: -19.91% | 1M: -32.29%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials and Utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: CHTR (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%), BKNG (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) and CMCSA (1W: +12.03% | 1M: +19.15%), all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: AAPL (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +2.23%) is in CORRECTION, while NVDA (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%) is BELOW TREND; trend confirmation remains important.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under broad pressure: NVDA (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%), GOOGL (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -19.38%) and META (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -16.11%) are BELOW TREND, while MSFT (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +1.16%) is ABOVE TREND. Sector return is -11.89% for the week and -14.09% for the month across 24 stocks; constituent-level positive breadth was not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed: the sector returned -0.45% for the week but +4.45% for the month across 20 stocks. V (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +13.57%) and MA (1W: +3.18% | 1M: +15.24%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -1.82% | 1M: +2.35%) is in CORRECTION; constituent-level positive breadth was not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is modestly positive (+0.46% 1W; +9.31% 1M); ABT (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +15.77%) and MDT (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.61%) are ABOVE TREND. JNJ (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%) and LLY (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +14.81%) are in CORRECTION, indicating short-term divergence from their monthly gains; constituent-level positive breadth was not provided.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Communication and Consumer Discretionary strength, while reducing exposure to deeply weak Technology names such as AMD (1W: -28.60% | 1M: -37.39%) and INTC (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%), both BELOW TREND. Style mixed / no clear leadership: sector performance is split, top-stock leadership is narrow, and major 1W/1M divergences make this a tactical market rather than a confirmed broad trend.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor CHTR (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%) and BKNG (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), both ABOVE TREND, for follow-through after strong advances. BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%) and INTC (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%), both BELOW TREND, for signs of stabilization or further weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+6.81% 1W) and Consumer Staples (+3.89% 1W) lead; overall breadth remains 6/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Technology (-11.89% 1W) and Energy (-10.19% 1W) are weakest, while Industrials are also negative at -2.71% 1W.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not included in the supplied data, so monitor return-based trend triggers instead: NVDA (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%) needs a clear improvement in weekly momentum to challenge its BELOW TREND status. AAPL (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +2.23%) and JPM (1W: -1.82% | 1M: +2.35%) remain CORRECTION cases; watch for weekly momentum to turn positive or monthly gains to give way.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+85): FDA approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO; JNJ (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%) is in CORRECTION, so positive news has not yet confirmed in weekly price action. LRCX (+75): announced a $25 billion repurchase authorization, but LRCX (1W: -27.20% | 1M: -43.80%) is BELOW TREND; sentiment-price divergence is pronounced.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-55): Cybertruck production wind-down; TSLA (1W: -14.78% | 1M: -9.03%) is BELOW TREND, confirming the negative catalyst. LOW (-55): guidance-cut concerns, though LOW (1W: +9.63% | 1M: +25.97%) is ABOVE TREND; CHTR (-45) faces a price-target reduction but remains ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%), both sentiment-price divergences. INTC (-45): weak fourth-quarter sales outlook aligns with INTC (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%) being BELOW TREND.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth is 6/11 sectors positive, leadership is Narrow (5/5 top performers across 2 sectors), and style is mixed / no clear leadership. CHTR (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%) and BKNG (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Major divergence and weak Technology momentum remain key risks; JNJ’s positive FDA news contrasts with its CORRECTION status (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%).
